title: Elijah Won, Then Ran for His Life
author: QUILL
notes: Distances straight-line. Horeb dashed (Jebel Musa traditional, uncertain). Not-proven line in beat 8.

beats.text: Elijah won, then ran for his life.
450 prophets of Baal stand against him. God's final answer isn't fire.
beats.say: 450 prophets of BAY-al stand against him. God's final answer isn't fire.

beats.text: On Mount Carmel, fire falls on a water-soaked altar, and the drought breaks.
beats.say: On Mount CAR-mel, fire falls on a water-soaked altar, and the drought breaks.

beats.text: He outruns Ahab's chariot, thirty kilometres to Jezreel. But Queen Jezebel threatens him.
beats.say: He outruns AY-hab's chariot, thirty kilometres to JEZ-reel. But Queen JEZ-eh-bel threatens him.

beats.text: He flees 150 kilometres south, to Beersheba, and begs God: take my life.
beats.say: He flees one hundred fifty kilometres south, to Beer-SHEE-ba, and begs God: take my life.

beats.text: An angel feeds him, and he walks forty days to Horeb.
beats.say: An angel feeds him, and he walks forty days to HOR-eb.
beats.label: DAYS

beats.text: Horeb, the mountain of God, is traditionally Jebel Musa.
beats.say: HOR-eb, the mountain of God, is traditionally JEB-el MOO-sa.

beats.text: Wind, earthquake, fire. God is in none of them.
beats.label: NOT IN THE STORM

beats.text: Then comes the answer: a still small voice.
Elijah won, then ran for his life. Fire, or silence: which hits harder?

youtube.title: Elijah Won, Then Ran for His Life 🗺️ #shorts
youtube.description:
On Mount Carmel, fire answers Elijah. Weeks later he hides in despair, and God's reply is not fire.
The site of Horeb is not proven; distances shown are straight-line.
#Elijah #MountCarmel #BibleHistory #MythUnearthed
